item.endring.end_ring.desc1: §8A ring fallen from the world's end, coiled in silence about its bearer, bound to their fate for all time.
item.endring.end_ring.desc3: §7Forges a near-unbreakable body; the wounded grow stronger.
item.endring.end_ring.desc4: §7Grants flight and sundry blessings in the wild.
item.endring.end_ring.desc5: §7Cheats death with totems; when spent, the End Dragon stirs.
